PSD: scipy.signal.welch per clean 2s epoch and each of 19 EEG channels; Hann; nperseg=512 at 256Hz (0.5Hz bins); noverlap=0; constant detrend; density scaling
band_aggregation: Sum PSD bins in each band, divide by that epoch/channel denominator, then median across clean epochs and EEG channels
band_endpoints: Lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive except gamma upper-inclusive at 45Hz
cross_dataset_preprocessing_limitation: Isfahan EDF uses assumed uV units and 0.5-45Hz Butterworth filtering; source signal preprocessing is not identical to OpenNeuro
denominator: Sum PSD bins from 1 through 45Hz separately for each epoch and channel
epochs: 2s, nonoverlapping; same three artifact rules as M5D-v2
filter: Butterworth 4th order 0.5-45 Hz, SOS zero-phase, full fixed first 300 seconds
legacy_feature_formula: Matches m3d_condition_transfer_v1.py whose EC reference features reproduced the original historical vectors
legacy_parity_status: Spectral feature formula reconciled with audited historical M3D extractor; different raw data preprocessing remains explicitly acknowledged
quality_gate: At least 15 clean epochs in each of five fixed minutes; exact equality with frozen M5D-v2 clean counts
ratio: Median theta fraction divided by max(median alpha fraction, 1e-12)
unit_assumption: Blank EDF physical dimensions treated as uV; MNE units="uV", then returned SI volts converted to uV for QC
unit_of_analysis: recording within release; cross-release identity not established
